summary.text: Spinning Golden Bell is Zheng Shan Chuan's refinement path killer move. Golden light forms a small spinning bell that sucks in refinement materials and collapses a long grind into a few breaths.

claims.text: In a Flying Frost Sect careful Gu duel against Fang Yuan, Zheng Shan Chuan slows under pressure, enters his aperture, and presses his glowing right hand down over the fire. After six breaths the cast leaves an incomplete careful Gu already formed, and spectators call the method a refinement path killer move, rarer than killer moves of other paths, and mark a youth succeeding with one as unusual talent.

Zheng Shan Chuan treats it as his trump card: six materials grind at once and the longest careful Gu step finishes early, so he pulls far ahead of Fang Yuan’s first look at the recipe. Old Man Qi Shan judges that even a matching refinement path killer move would be unsafe for Fang Yuan on a first careful Gu attempt, because the usual safe path is to refine those six materials one by one while controlling the fire.
